fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
"Build+test (stable, windows-latest)" runs 11 min in one job: shard it
Jobs wait 76 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider
Packages depend on each other in a cycle, rustls ↔ rustls-aws-lc-rs ↔ rustls-ring ↔ rustls-test ↔ rustls-util: break it, so an edit to one stops reaching the rest
